At Register. This NOTICE sign from CGAP Safety reads: GIFT CARDS / AT REGISTER. Written for beauty supply stores and cosmetics shops.

Why this sign matters

Puts the rule for the beauty gift cards in plain words right where people need it, so it gets followed instead of ignored.

Where to post it

At the beauty gift cards.

Who orders it

Store managers.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. A sign supports your site rules; it does not replace training or supervision.
